name: Honor timer requests system-wide
description: Windows 11 limits a program's timer resolution request to that program only. This restores the global behavior so a 0.5 millisecond request from Game Boost reaches the game.

name: Disable accessibility key popups
description: Stops Sticky Keys, Filter Keys and Toggle Keys from interrupting a game when Shift is pressed five times or a key is held down. Applies after the next sign in.

name: Optimizations for windowed games
description: Runs borderless and windowed DirectX 10 and 11 games through the modern flip presentation model, which cuts input latency to nearly that of exclusive fullscreen.

name: Disable USB selective suspend
description: Keeps USB ports awake while plugged in, so a mouse or keyboard never needs a wake up delay after a pause.

name: Disable PCIe link power saving
description: Stops the graphics card link from dropping into a low power state while plugged in, which removes a wake up delay when a frame is needed.

name: Keep all CPU cores awake
description: Disables core parking while plugged in, so work can start on any core immediately instead of waiting for one to wake up.

name: Keep the CPU at full speed
description: Pins the minimum processor state at 100 percent while plugged in. Lowest response time, but constant heat and power draw. Game Boost does this only while a game runs.
